name: @estebanforge/pi-asana
description: Asana Work Graph tool for Pi. Adds 12 LLM-callable tools (asana_*) that query the Asana REST API over plain HTTP. Mirrors a curated subset of the official Asana MCP tool set — no MCP server install required. Personal access token auth via ASANA_ACCE
